lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a public vote on who leads Telluride Regional Medical Center — the hospital board meets Wednesday in a special session, takes public comment, then comes out of executive session to name interim leadership. That same packed Wednesday also brings a Telluride Town Council meeting where two affordable units at 215 East Colorado Avenue could lose their price caps and convert to employee dwelling units, plus a Housing Authority vote on the same deed-restriction change. Blues & Brews kicks off Thursday and runs through the weekend.

notable.stake: Board votes publicly on who leads the hospital in the near term.
Ordinance would move MVHA affordable housing fees out of municipal code, changing how costs get set.
Comp Plan update shapes long-range land use and density for all of Telluride — public engagement phase active.
Resolution would remove price caps on two town-built affordable units, converting them to employee dwellings.
Council votes on deed-restriction conversion and holds three public hearings on related ordinances second reading.
